title: Terah (Thara)
summary: Son of Nahor; father of Abram, Nahor and Haran (Gen 11:26). Took his family from Ur of the Chaldees to Haran, where he died aged 205 (Gen 11:31-32).
description: Masoretic text: born AM 1878 (when his father was the age given in Gen 11), lived 205 years, died AM 2083. No CFAH paper dates this person; the sort year falls to Ussher.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 4: Ussher, Annals (1658): 2126 BC (no higher-tier year available).

birth.citation: Jones, Chronology of the Old Testament (15th ed., 2002), "Chronological Compendium", p. 1 ("Terah born when Nahor was 29 ... 1878")
Gen 11:10–26 (Arphaxad AM 1658 = Shem's 100th year, two years after the Flood of AM 1656; each later birth adds the father's age at the named son)
Ussher, Annals of the World, Second Age §54 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)
Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 2)," Biblical Chronology 6:4 (April 1994), §8 "The Chronology of Genesis 11" (year list)
Anno Mundi Chronology Studies (unnamed compiler; a compilation of James B. Jordan's system), p. 2, chart "Genesis 11:10 – 12 Genealogy"
birth.note: Agrees with Jordan's own published AM 1878.

birth.date: "Nahor begat Haran when he was one hundred and twenty years old"
birth.note: Whiston's text names the son "Haran" here, but the series runs Nahor → Terah; Josephus' 120 differs from the Masoretic 29 (Gen 11:24). Treat as a Josephus/Whiston reading, not a date.

death.note: Not stated in the Jones sources read (Chart No. 1; Chronology of the Old Testament 15th ed. 2002). Leave empty until verified.

death.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Second Age §70 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)
death.note: Ussher narrates Terah's death at the end of §70 under "2083a AM, 2792 JP, 1922 BC"; §71 ("After Terah died", 2083 AM, 1921 BC) begins the 430 years.

death.citation: Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 2)," Biblical Chronology 6:4 (April 1994), §8 "The Chronology of Genesis 11" (year list)
Anno Mundi Chronology Studies (unnamed compiler; a compilation of James B. Jordan's system), p. 2, chart "Genesis 11:10 – 12 Genealogy"
death.note: Agrees with Jordan's own published AM 2083.

death.date: "where Terah died, and was buried, when he had lived to be two hundred and five years old"

open_questions: Gen 11:26 ("Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran") is read by Ussher, Jones, CFAH and Jordan as Abram born when Terah was 130 (Gen 11:32 + 12:4 + Acts 7:4); scripture_facts.age_at_named_son = 70 records the verse as written. See abraham-birth.
